title: finance-dashboard
text:
Pushed and opened: Atemndobs/financial-dashboard#26

Branch fix/foreign-income-ownership-check → main, one commit, three files.

Two notes:

The repo is public, so the PR describes the vulnerability while it is still unfixed on main. Given the window is short and exploitation needs a valid Clerk session on your instance, that seemed the right tradeoff over an opaque description, but merge sooner rather than later.

After merging, deploy Convex before Vercel. The mutation now requires userId, so a Vercel deploy landing first would break deletes for real.

Your checklist work is still parked in stash@{0}:
